<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
	<meta charset="utf-8">
	<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
	<title>Guide &ndash; Getting started</title>
	<link rel="stylesheet" href="/guide/css/theme.css">
	<link rel=icon href=/favicon.ico type=image/x-icon>
	<base href="/guide/">
</head>
<body class=start data-version=2.4.0>
	<!-- Header with navigation -->
	<header>
		<nav aria-label="Main navigation">
			<ul>
				<li><a href="getting-started/" aria-current="page">Getting started</a></li>
				<li><a href="billing/">Billing</a></li>
				<li><a href='account/security/'>Security</a></li>
			</ul>
		</nav>
	</header>

	<main id="content">
		<h1>Getting started</h1>
		<p>Sign in with your work&shy;space account. Problems? Write to
			<a href="mailto:support@example.com?subject=Login%20&amp;%20Password">support@example.com</a>.</p>
		<p>Entities: &amp; &lt;tag&gt; &quot;quoted&quot; &apos; &nbsp; &#x41; &#65; &euro; &copy; &unknown; &amp</p>
		<hr>
		<img src="images/login.png" alt="Login form with “User name” and “Password” fields" width=640 height="360" loading=lazy>
		<br/>
		<form action="/login" method="post" novalidate>
			<label for="user">User name</label>
			<input id="user" name="user" type="text" required autocomplete="username">
			<input type="password" name="password" minlength=8 placeholder='at least 8 characters'>
			<input type="checkbox" id="remember" checked disabled><label for="remember">Stay signed in</label>
			<button type="submit" class="button button--primary" onclick="this.disabled = true; this.form.submit();">Sign in</button>
		</form>
		<table>
			<caption>Roles</caption>
			<tr><th scope="col">Role</th><th scope="col">Permissions</th></tr>
			<tr><td>Viewer</td><td>Read pages, comment</td></tr>
			<tr><td>Editor</td><td>Publish, manage redirects</td></tr>
		</table>
		<pre><code>npm run build &amp;&amp; php bin/serve.php</code></pre>
	</main>

	<footer><small>&copy; 2026 Example Press &middot; <a href="/imprint">Imprint</a></small></footer>
	<script src="/guide/js/toc.js" defer></script>
</body>
</html>
